verdict.rationale: Cline ships first-party IDE extensions for VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains, Windsurf and others. It works through natural conversation inside the editor, can read the codebase for context, and shows edits as reviewable diffs in the IDE. Community users report daily-driving it as an editor-embedded agent. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on evidence that specifically covers the quality of in-IDE contextual chat (e.g., editor selection/context passing).

support.subject: As a developer, I can chat with the coding assistant directly inside my IDE for contextual help
